@dev Contract module that allows children to implement role-based access
 control mechanisms. This is a lightweight version that doesn't allow enumerating role
 members except through off-chain means by accessing the contract event logs. Some
 applications may benefit from on-chain enumerability, for those cases see
 {AccessControlEnumerable}.
 Roles are referred to by their `bytes32` identifier. These should be exposed
 in the external API and be unique. The best way to achieve this is by
 using `public constant` hash digests:
 ```
 bytes32 public constant MY_ROLE = keccak256("MY_ROLE");
 ```
 Roles can be used to represent a set of permissions. To restrict access to a
 function call, use {hasRole}:
 ```
 function foo() public {
     require(hasRole(MY_ROLE, msg.sender));
     ...
 }
 ```
 Roles can be granted and revoked dynamically via the {grantRole} and
 {revokeRole} functions. Each role has an associated admin role, and only
 accounts that have a role's admin role can call {grantRole} and {revokeRole}.
 By default, the admin role for all roles is `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, which means
 that only accounts with this role will be able to grant or revoke other
 roles. More complex role relationships can be created by using
 {_setRoleAdmin}.
 WARNING: The `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is also its own admin: it has permission to
 grant and revoke this role. Extra precautions should be taken to secure
 accounts that have been granted it.

@dev Returns true if `account` is a contract.
 [IMPORTANT]
 ====
 It is unsafe to assume that an address for which this function returns
 false is an externally-owned account (EOA) and not a contract.
 Among others, `isContract` will return false for the following
 types of addresses:
  - an externally-owned account
  - a contract in construction
  - an address where a contract will be created
  - an address where a contract lived, but was destroyed
 ====
 [IMPORTANT]
 ====
 You shouldn't rely on `isContract` to protect against flash loan attacks!
 Preventing calls from contracts is highly discouraged. It breaks composability, breaks support for smart wallets
 like Gnosis Safe, and does not provide security since it can be circumvented by calling from a contract
 constructor.
 ====

@dev Replacement for Solidity's `transfer`: sends `amount` wei to
 `recipient`, forwarding all available gas and reverting on errors.
 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1884[EIP1884] increases the gas cost
 of certain opcodes, possibly making contracts go over the 2300 gas limit
 imposed by `transfer`, making them unable to receive funds via
 `transfer`. {sendValue} removes this limitation.
 https://diligence.consensys.net/posts/2019/09/stop-using-soliditys-transfer-now/[Learn more].
 IMPORTANT: because control is transferred to `recipient`, care must be
 taken to not create reentrancy vulnerabilities. Consider using
 {ReentrancyGuard} or the
 https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/v0.5.11/security-considerations.html#use-the-checks-effects-interactions-pattern[checks-effects-interactions pattern].

@dev Performs a Solidity function call using a low level `call`. A
 plain `call` is an unsafe replacement for a function call: use this
 function instead.
 If `target` reverts with a revert reason, it is bubbled up by this
 function (like regular Solidity function calls).
 Returns the raw returned data. To convert to the expected return value,
 use https://solidity.readthedocs.io/en/latest/units-and-global-variables.html?highlight=abi.decode#abi-encoding-and-decoding-functions[`abi.decode`].
 Requirements:
 - `target` must be a contract.
 - calling `target` with `data` must not revert.
 _Available since v3.1._

// OpenZeppelin Contracts v4.4.1 (token/ERC20/extensions/draft-IERC20Permit.sol)

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC20 Permit extension allowing approvals to be made via signatures, as defined in
 * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612[EIP-2612].
 *
 * Adds the {permit} method, which can be used to change an account's ERC20 allowance (see {IERC20-allowance}) by
 * presenting a message signed by the account. By not relying on {IERC20-approve}, the token holder account doesn't
 * need to send a transaction, and thus is not required to hold Ether at all.
 */
interface IERC20Permit {
    /**
     * @dev Sets `value` as the allowance of `spender` over ``owner``'s tokens,
     * given ``owner``'s signed approval.
     *
     * IMPORTANT: The same issues {IERC20-approve} has related to transaction
     * ordering also apply here.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `spender` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `deadline` must be a timestamp in the future.
     * - `v`, `r` and `s` must be a valid `secp256k1` signature from `owner`
     * over the EIP712-formatted function arguments.
     * - the signature must use ``owner``'s current nonce (see {nonces}).
     *
     * For more information on the signature format, see the
     * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2612#specification[relevant EIP
     * section].
     */
    function permit(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external;

    /**
     * @dev Returns the current nonce for `owner`. This value must be
     * included whenever a signature is generated for {permit}.
     *
     * Every successful call to {permit} increases ``owner``'s nonce by one. This
     * prevents a signature from being used multiple times.
     */
    function nonces(address owner) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the domain separator used in the encoding of the signature for {permit}, as defined by {EIP712}.
     */
    // solhint-disable-next-line func-name-mixedcase
    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32);
}

devdoc.details: Wrappers around ERC20 operations that throw on failure (when the token contract returns false). Tokens that return no value (and instead revert or throw on failure) are also supported, non-reverting calls are assumed to be successful. To use this library you can add a `using SafeERC20 for IERC20;` statement to your contract, which allows you to call the safe operations as `token.safeTransfer(...)`, etc.

devdoc.details: Implementation of the {IERC165} interface. Contracts that want to implement ERC165 should inherit from this contract and override {supportsInterface} to check for the additional interface id that will be supported. For example: ```solidity function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override returns (bool) {     return interfaceId == type(MyInterface).interfaceId || super.supportsInterface(interfaceId); } ``` Alternatively, {ERC165Storage} provides an easier to use but more expensive implementation.

Interface of the ERC165 standard, as defined in the https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165[EIP]. Implementers can declare support of contract interfaces, which can then be queried by others ({ERC165Checker}). For an implementation, see {ERC165}.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[EIP section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this. _Available since v3.1._

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

   list.pop();\r\n                return;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0xa3a2c320711ddf9e689c429d07c5a2cb445a545036fad0f3b77a92ebfeed3f24","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/CoSigningManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ReputationManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./LendingPool.sol\";\r\n\r\n//Manages co-signing relationships where trusted users can vouch for borrowers\r\ncontract CoSigningManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    LendingPool public immutable lendingPool;\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextRequestId = 1;\r\n    uint256 public nextRecordId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRequest) public coSigningRequests;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRecord) public coSigningRecords;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanCoSigners; // loanId      => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userRequests; // borrower    => requestIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userCoSignings; // coSigner    => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(uint256 => address) public offerCoSigner;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public offerToCoSignRecord;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => bool) public offerHasActiveRequest;\r\n\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public offerToRecords; // loanOfferId => recordIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Co-signing limits\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION = 50; //to be changed back to 200\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant COOLDOWN_PERIOD = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN = 3;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRequest {\r\n        uint256 requestId;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n        string message;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRecord {\r\n        uint256 recordId;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 reputationStaked;\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided;\r\n        uint256 coSignTimestamp;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        bool loanCompleted;\r\n        bool borrowerDefaulted;\r\n        bool wasCancelled;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string message\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningCompleted(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningReleased(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerPenalized(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerRewarded(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 rewardAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordAlreadyLinked();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CoSignerCannotBeLender();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestAlreadyExists();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__AlreadyCoSigned();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _reputationManager, address _lendingPool) {\r\n        if (_reputationManager == address(0) || _lendingPool == address(0)) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        lendingPool = LendingPool(_lendingPool);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE, _lendingPool);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Request Management ============\r\n\r\n    function createCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string calldata message\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {\r\n        if (requestedBonus == 0) revert CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.LoanOffer memory offer = lendingPool.getLoanOffer(\r\n            loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n\r\n        // Only the offer creator can request co-signing for their own offer\r\n        if (offer.creator != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        // Block duplicate active requests for the same offer\r\n        if (offerHasActiveRequest[loanOfferId])\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestAlreadyExists();\r\n\r\n        // Block if already co-signed (accepted)\r\n        if (offerCoSigner[loanOfferId] != address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__AlreadyCoSigned();\r\n\r\n        requestId = nextRequestId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRequests[requestId] = CoSigningRequest({\r\n            requestId: requestId,\r\n            borrower: msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId: loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus: requestedBonus,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp,\r\n            message: message\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userRequests[msg.sender].push(requestId);\r\n        offerHasActiveRequest[loanOfferId] = true;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n            requestId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus,\r\n            message\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return requestId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRequest(uint256 requestId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (request.borrower != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n        delete offerCoSigner[request.loanOfferId];\r\n        offerHasActiveRequest[request.loanOfferId] = false;\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCancelled(requestId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function acceptCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 recordId) {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (msg.sender == request.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            msg.sender\r\n        );\r\n        if (coSignerReputation < MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Actual bonus determined by ReputationManager \u2014 requestedBonus is ignored here\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided = reputationManager.addCoSigningBonus(\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            coSignerReputation,\r\n            request.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        recordId = nextRecordId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRecords[recordId] = CoSigningRecord({\r\n            recordId: recordId,\r\n            coSigner: msg.sender,\r\n            borrower: request.borrower,\r\n            loanId: 0,\r\n            loanOfferId: request.loanOfferId,\r\n            reputationStaked: coSignerReputation,\r\n            bonusProvided: bonusProvided,\r\n            coSignTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            loanCompleted: false,\r\n            borrowerDefaulted: false,\r\n            wasCancelled: false\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userCoSignings[msg.sender].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        //   look up this record by offer ID and reverse the bonus if needed.\r\n        offerToRecords[request.loanOfferId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        offerCoSigner[request.loanOfferId] = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n        offerToCoSignRecord[request.loanOfferId] = recordId;\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate the request \u2014 one co-signer per request\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            0,\r\n            bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return recordId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRecord(uint256 recordId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        // Only the borrower or LendingPool (admin) can cancel\r\n        if (\r\n            msg.sender != record.borrower &&\r\n            !hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n        record.wasCancelled = true;\r\n\r\n        // Reverse the reputation bonus given to the borrower\r\n        reputationManager.clearOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Decrement the co-signer's active co-sign count\r\n        reputationManager.decrementActiveCoSigns(record.coSigner);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower\r\n        );\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            false\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function addCoSignerToLoan(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 coSignRecordId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[coSignRecordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.Loan memory loan = lendingPool.getLoan(loanId);\r\n        if (loan.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n        if (loan.borrower != record.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        if (loan.lender == record.coSigner)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CoSignerCannotBeLender();\r\n\r\n        if (loanCoSigners[loanId].length >= MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(coSignRecordId);\r\n\r\n        reputationManager.applyOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            coSignRecordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    //logic for either repayment or default\r\n    function releaseCoSigning(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n\r\n        // Clear the borrower's co-signing bonus on release\r\n        reputationManager.clearOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (successfulRepayment) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(record.coSigner, record.borrower);\r\n            emit CoSignerRewarded(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                10\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            record.borrowerDefaulted = true;\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked\r\n            );\r\n            emit CoSignerPenalized(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked / 3\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            successfulRepayment\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function linkRecordToLoan(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n        if (record.loanId != 0) revert CoSigningManager__RecordAlreadyLinked();\r\n\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function getRecordsByOffer(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return offerToRecords[loanOfferId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function calculateCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 bonus) {\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            coSigner\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 baseBonus = (coSignerReputation * MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE) / 100;\r\n        uint256 coSignCount = reputationManager.getCoSignCount(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            borrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (coSignCount == 0) {\r\n            return baseBonus;\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 1) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 60) / 100;\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 2) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 30) / 100;\r\n        } else {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 10) / 100;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function handleOfferCancelled(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) {\r\n        reputationManager.clearOfferCoSigningBonus(borrower, loanOfferId);\r\n\r\n        uint256 recordId = offerToCoSignRecord[loanOfferId];\r\n        if (recordId != 0) {\r\n            CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n            if (record.isActive) {\r\n                record.isActive = false;\r\n                reputationManager.decrementActiveCoSigns(record.coSigner);\r\n                emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n                    recordId,\r\n                    record.coSigner,\r\n                    borrower,\r\n                    false\r\n                );\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        delete offerCoSigner[loanOfferId];\r\n        delete offerToCoSignRecord[loanOfferId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningRecord(\r\n        uint256 recordId\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRecord memory) {\r\n        return coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest memory) {\r\n        return coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userRequests[borrower];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory requestIds = userRequests[borrower];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) activeCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory activeRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRequests[index++] = coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getUserCoSignings(\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userCoSignings[coSigner];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveCoSignings(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRecord[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = userCoSignings[user];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) activeCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRecord[] memory activeRecords = new CoSigningRecord[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRecords[index++] = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRecords;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function hasDiminishingReturns(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return reputationManager.hasDiminishingReturns(coSigner, borrower);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningStats(\r\n        address user\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (\r\n            uint256 totalCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 activeCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 successfulCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 defaultedCoSignings\r\n        )\r\n    {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = userCoSignings[user];\r\n        totalCoSignings = recordIds.length;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CoSigningRecord memory record = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n            if (record.isActive) {\r\n                activeCoSignings++;\r\n            } else if (record.loanCompleted) {\r\n                if (record.borrowerDefaulted) {\r\n                    defaultedCoSignings++;\r\n                } else if (!record.wasCancelled) {\r\n                    successfulCoSignings++;\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return (\r\n            totalCoSignings,\r\n            activeCoSignings,\r\n            successfulCoSignings,\r\n            defaultedCoSignings\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getAllOpenRequests()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        uint256 totalRequests = nextRequestId - 1;\r\n        uint256 openCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) openCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory openRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            openCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) {\r\n                openRequests[index++] = coSigningRequests[i];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return openRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getLoanCoSigners(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return loanCoSigners[loanId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function isCoSignerForOffer(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        address account\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return offerCoSigner[loanOfferId] == account;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x0ca3662c72b88a0a9dee0a1b6d3fc0cc90811583175377cdbcb74e20a5ed6713","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/CollateralManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./PriceOracle.sol\";\r\n\r\n//Manages collateral deposits, withdrawals, and liquidations for lending platform\r\ncontract CollateralManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant LIQUIDATOR_ROLE = keccak256(\"LIQUIDATOR_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    PriceOracle public immutable priceOracle;\r\n\r\n    // Collateral deposits\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CollateralDeposit) public deposits;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanToDepositIds; // loanId => depositIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userDepositIds; // user => depositIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Token information\r\n    mapping(address => TokenInfo) public supportedTokens;\r\n    mapping(address => uint8) public tokenDecimals;\r\n    address[] public supportedTokenList;\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextDepositId;\r\n\r\n    // Liquidation parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 11000; // 110% (in basis points)\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO = 12000; // 120% (in basis (give borrowers extra time after loan overdue)\r\n    uint256 public constant LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CollateralDeposit {\r\n        uint256 depositId;\r\n        address depositor;\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        bool isLocked;\r\n        uint256   uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralWithdrawn(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        address indexed depositor,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralUnlocked(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed depositId,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        address liquidator,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 recoveredValue\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenAdded(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event TokenRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event TokenConfigUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 error CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n    error CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n    error CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error error CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _priceOracle) {\r\n        if (_priceOracle == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].isSupported)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n\r\n        // Verify token is supported by price    isSupported: true,\r\n            maxDepositAmount: maxDepositAmount,\r\n            liquidationPenalty: liquidationPenalty,\r\n            totalDeposited: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        tokenDecimals[token] = decimals_;\r\n        supportedTokenList.push(token);\r\n\r\n        emit TokenAdded(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function removeSupportedToken(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Check no active deposits\r\n        if (supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited > 0) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InvalidToken();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].isSupported = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from list\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokenList.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokenList[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokenList[i] = supportedTokenList[\r\n                    supportedTokenList.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokenList.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit TokenRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function updateTokenConfig(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 maxDepositAmount,\r\n        uint256 liquidationPenalty\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[token].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        supportedTokens[token].maxDepositAmount = maxDepositAmount;\r\n        supportedTokens[token].liquidationPenalty = liquidationPenalty;\r\n\r\n        emit TokenConfigUpdated(token, maxDepositAmount, liquidationPenalty);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function depositCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        address tokenAddress,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 depositId) {\r\n        if (!supportedTokens[tokenAddress].isSupported) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__TokenNotSupported();\r\n        }\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        TokenInfo storage tokenInfo = supportedTokens[tokenAddress];\r\n\r\n        // Check max deposit\r\n        if (amount > tokenInfo.maxDepositAmount) {\r\n            revert CollateralManager__MaxDepositExceeded();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        depositId = nextDepositId++;\r\n\r\n        deposits[depositId] = CollateralDeposit({\r\n            depositId: depositId,\r\n            depositor: msg.sender,\r\n            tokenAddress: tokenAddress,\r\n            amount: amount,\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            isLocked: false,\r\n            depositTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            lockedTimestamp: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        loanToDepositIds[loanId].push(depositId);\r\n        userDepositIds[msg.sender].push(depositId);\r\n\r\n        tokenInfo.totalDeposited += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens from user to this contract\r\n        IERC20(tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            address(this),\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralDeposited(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            tokenAddress,\r\n            amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return depositId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function withdrawCollateral(uint256 depositId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.depositor != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__UnauthorizedWithdrawal();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n\r\n        address token = deposit.tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 amount = deposit.amount;\r\n        address depositor = deposit.depositor;\r\n\r\n        // Update state\r\n        supportedTokens[token].totalDeposited -= amount;\r\n        delete deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        // Transfer tokens back to user\r\n        IERC20(token).safeTransfer(depositor, amount);\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralWithdrawn(depositId, depositor, token, amount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function lockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositLocked();\r\n        if (deposit.loanId != loanId) revert CollateralManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = true;\r\n        deposit.lockedTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralLocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount,\r\n            block.timestamp\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function unlockCollateral(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositId];\r\n\r\n        if (deposit.depositor == address(0))\r\n            revert CollateralManager__DepositNotFound();\r\n        if (!deposit.isLocked) revert CollateralManager__DepositNotLocked();\r\n\r\n        deposit.isLocked = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CollateralUnlocked(\r\n            depositId,\r\n            deposit.loanId,\r\n            deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n            deposit.amount\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function liquidateCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        address lender,\r\n        bool enforceGracePeriod\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE)\r\n        nonReentrant\r\n        returns (uint256 recoveredAmount)\r\n    {\r\n        if (lender == address(0)) revert CollateralManager__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        if (depositIds.length == 0)\r\n            revert CollateralManager__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n        uint256 totalRecovered = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit storage deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (!deposit.isLocked) continue;\r\n\r\n            // Check grace period\r\n            if (\r\n                enforceGracePeriod &&\r\n                block.timestamp <\r\n                deposit.lockedTimestamp + LIQUIDATION_GRACE_PERIOD\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert CollateralManager__GracePeriodActive();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get collateral value in usd\r\n            uint256 collateralValue = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Calculate how much USD value the lender needs:\r\n            // unpaid amount + 5% liquidation bonus\r\n            uint256 lenderEntitlement = (loanAmount *\r\n                (BASIS_POINTS + LIQUIDATION_BONUS)) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n\r\n            uint256 lenderTokenAmount;\r\n            uint256 borrowerTokenAmount;\r\n\r\n            if (collateralValue <= lenderEntitlement) {\r\n                // Collateral is not enough to cover full entitlement\r\n                // Lender gets everything\r\n                lenderTokenAmount = deposit.amount;\r\n                borrowerTokenAmount = 0;\r\n            } else {\r\n                // Collateral covers lender entitlement \u2014 return remainder to borrower\r\n                // lenderTokenAmount = deposit.amount * (lenderEntitlement / collateralValue)\r\n                lenderTokenAmount =\r\n                    (deposit.amount * lenderEntitlement) /\r\n                    collateralValue;\r\n                borrowerTokenAmount = deposit.amount - lenderTokenAmount;\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            totalRecovered +=\r\n                (lenderTokenAmount * collateralValue) /\r\n                deposit.amount;\r\n\r\n            // Transfer lender's portion\r\n            IERC20(deposit.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                lender,\r\n                lenderTokenAmount\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            // Return remainder to borrower if any\r\n            if (borrowerTokenAmount > 0) {\r\n                IERC20(deposit.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                    deposit.depositor,\r\n                    borrowerTokenAmount\r\n                );\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Update state\r\n            supportedTokens[deposit.tokenAddress].totalDeposited -= deposit\r\n                .amount;\r\n\r\n            emit CollateralLiquidated(\r\n                depositIds[i],\r\n                loanId,\r\n                deposit.depositor,\r\n                lender,\r\n                deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                deposit.amount,\r\n                totalRecovered\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            delete deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Clear loan deposits\r\n        delete loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n\r\n        return totalRecovered;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getLoanCollateralValue(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        uint256 totalValue = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CollateralDeposit memory deposit = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n\r\n            if (deposit.amount > 0) {\r\n                uint256 value = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n                    deposit.tokenAddress,\r\n                    deposit.amount,\r\n                    tokenDecimals[deposit.tokenAddress]\r\n                );\r\n                totalValue += value;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return totalValue;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCollateralDeposit(\r\n        uint256 depositId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit memory) {\r\n        return deposits[depositId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getLoanCollateral(\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = loanToDepositIds[loanId];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory loanDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            loanDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return loanDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getUserDeposits(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (CollateralDeposit[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory depositIds = userDepositIds[user];\r\n        CollateralDeposit[] memory userDeposits = new CollateralDeposit[](\r\n            depositIds.length\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositIds.length; i++) {\r\n            userDeposits[i] = deposits[depositIds[i]];\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return userDeposits;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function isCollateralSufficient(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount,\r\n        uint256 requiredRatio\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return true;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        uint256 actualRatio = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return actualRatio >= requiredRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function calculateHealthFactor(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 healthFactor) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return type(uint256).max;\r\n\r\n        uint256 collateralValue = this.getLoanCollateralValue(loanId);\r\n        healthFactor = (collateralValue * BASIS_POINTS) / loanAmount;\r\n\r\n        return healthFactor;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function canLiquidate(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) return false;\r\n\r\n        uint256 healthFactor = this.calculateHealthFactor(loanId, loanAmount);\r\n\r\n        // Can liquidate if health factor below threshold (110%)\r\n        return healthFactor < LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokenList;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getTokenInfo(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (TokenInfo memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens[token];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getTokenUSDValue(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        uint8 decimals = tokenDecimals[token];\r\n        return (CollateralValue memory) {\r\n        uint256 valueInUSD = priceOracle.getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n            token,\r\n            amount,\r\n            tokenDecimals[token]\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return\r\n            CollateralValue({\r\n                tokenAddress: token,\r\n                amount: amount,\r\n                valueInUSD: valueInUSD,\r\n                lastUpdated: block.timestamp\r\n            });\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x0f71731ab0c4a03b35401edb42121268c8c937196ee5eae64211039789378ec6","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LendingPool.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: matching\r\ncontract LendingPool is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\r\n\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public constant LIQUIDATION_THRESHOLD = 11000; //110%\r\n\r\n    address public feeCollector;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Enums ============\r\n\r\n    enum LoanStatus {\r\n        PENDING,\r\n        ACTIVE,\r\n        REPAID,\r\n        DEFAULTED,\r\n        CANCELLED\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    enum LoanType {\r\n        LENDER_OFFER,\r\n        BORROW_REQUEST\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct LoanTerms {\r\n        address tokenAddress;\r\n        uint256 principalAmount;\r\n        uint256 collateralAmount;\r\n        address collateralToken;\r\n        uint256 interestRate;\r\n        uint256 duration;\r\n        uint256 minReputation;\r\n        uint256 collateralRatio;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct LoanOffer {\r\n        uint256 offerId;\r\n        LoanType offerType;\r\n        address creator;\r\n        LoanTerms terms;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct Loan {\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n uint256 duration\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanOfferCancelled(uint256 indexed offerId, address indexed creator);\r\n\r\n    event LoanMatched(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        uint256    address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event LoanRepaid(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed );\r\n\r\n    event CollateralLiquidated(\r\n        uint256 indexed loanId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event indexed oldManager,\r\n        address indexed newManager\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n    error LendingPool__LoanNotOverdue();\r\n    error LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n    error LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n    error
