============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(\r\n        address _reputationManager,\r\n        address _collateralManager,\r\n        address _feeCollector\r\n    ) {\r\n        if (\r\n            _reputationManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _collateralManager == address(0) ||\r\n            _feeCollector == address(0)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        collateralManager = CollateralManager(_collateralManager);\r\n        feeCollector = _feeCollector;\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Offer Management ============\r\n\r\n    function createLoanOffer(\r\n        LoanType offerType,\r\n        LoanTerms calldata terms\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 offerId) {\r\n        _validateLoanTerms(terms, offerType);\r\n\r\n        offerId = nextOfferId++;\r\n\r\n        loanOffers[offerId] = LoanOffer({\r\n            offerId: offerId,\r\n            offerType: offerType,\r\n            creator: msg.sender,\r\n            terms: terms,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userOffers[msg.sender].push(offerId);\r\n\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            activeLenderOffers.push(offerId);\r\n\r\n            // Lender locks funds upfront\r\n            IERC20(terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            activeBorrowerRequests.push(offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCreated(\r\n            offerId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            offerType,\r\n            terms.principalAmount,\r\n            terms.interestRate,\r\n            terms.duration\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return offerId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function cancelLoanOffer(uint256 offerId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n        if (offer.creator != msg.sender)\r\n            revert LendingPool__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        if (address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            try\r\n                coSigningManager.handleOfferCancelled(offerId, offer.creator)\r\n            {} catch {}\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Remove from active lists\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Return locked funds to lender\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                msg.sender,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanOfferCancelled(offerId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function acceptLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId,\r\n        uint256 collateralDepositId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 loanId) {\r\n        LoanOffer storage offer = loanOffers[offerId];\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0)) revert LendingPool__OfferNotFound();\r\n        if (!offer.isActive) revert LendingPool__OfferNotActive();\r\n\r\n        address lender;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            // Lender created the offer \u2014 msg.sender is the borrower\r\n            lender = offer.creator;\r\n            borrower = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n            // Enforce minimum reputation for borrower\r\n            if (\r\n                !reputationManager.meetsReputationRequirement(\r\n                    borrower,\r\n                    offer.terms.minReputation\r\n                )\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert LendingPool__InsufficientReputation();\r\n            }\r\n        } else {\r\n            // Borrower created the request \u2014 msg.sender is the lender\r\n            lender = msg.sender;\r\n            borrower = offer.creator;\r\n\r\n            if (\r\n                address(coSigningManager) != address(0) &&\r\n                coSigningManager.isCoSignerForOffer(offerId, msg.sender)\r\n            ) {\r\n                revert LendingPool__CoSignerCannotBeLender();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Lender provides funds now\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n                lender,\r\n                address(this),\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Verify and lock collateral\r\n        if (collateralDepositId != 0) {\r\n            bool sufficient = collateralManager.isCollateralSufficient(\r\n                collateralDepositId,\r\n                offer.terms.principalAmount,\r\n                offer.terms.collateralRatio\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            if (!sufficient) revert LendingPool__InsufficientCollateral();\r\n\r\n            collateralManager.lockCollateral(collateralDepositId, nextLoanId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Create the loan\r\n        loanId = nextLoanId++;\r\n\r\n        loans[loanId] = Loan({\r\n            loanId: loanId,\r\n            loanType: offer.offerType,\r\n            lender: lender,\r\n            borrower: borrower,\r\n            terms: offer.terms,\r\n            status: LoanStatus.ACTIVE,\r\n            startTime: block.timestamp,\r\n            dueTime: block.timestamp + offer.terms.duration,\r\n            amountRepaid: 0,\r\n            collateralDepositId: collateralDepositId,\r\n            hasCoSigner: false,\r\n            coSigner: address(0)\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userLoans[lender].push(loanId);\r\n        userLoans[borrower].push(loanId);\r\n\r\n        if (address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getRecordsByOffer(\r\n                offerId\r\n            );\r\n\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                CoSigningManager.CoSigningRecord\r\n                    memory record = coSigningManager.getCoSigningRecord(\r\n                        recordIds[i]\r\n                    );\r\n\r\n                if (record.isActive && !record.wasCancelled) {\r\n                    // Link this record to the newly created loan\r\n                    coSigningManager.linkRecordToLoan(recordIds[i], loanId);\r\n\r\n                    // Update loan struct to reflect co-signer\r\n                    loans[loanId].hasCoSigner = true;\r\n                    loans[loanId].coSigner = record.coSigner;\r\n\r\n                    break; // Only one co-signer per loan for now\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate offer and remove from active list\r\n        offer.isActive = false;\r\n        if (offer.offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeLenderOffers, offerId);\r\n        } else {\r\n            ActiveOfferLib.remove(activeBorrowerRequests, offerId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Transfer principal to borrower (minus platform fee)\r\n        uint256 platformFee = (offer.terms.principalAmount * platformFeeRate) /\r\n            BASIS_POINTS;\r\n        uint256 amountToBorrower = offer.terms.principalAmount - platformFee;\r\n\r\n        IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            amountToBorrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (platformFee > 0) {\r\n            IERC20(offer.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransfer(\r\n                feeCollector,\r\n                platformFee\r\n            );\r\n            emit PlatformFeeCollected(loanId, platformFee);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanMatched(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            offerId,\r\n            lender,\r\n            borrower,\r\n            offer.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return loanId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Loan Management ============\r\n\r\n    function repayLoan(uint256 loanId, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n        if (amount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidRepaymentAmount();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 remainingAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        if (amount > remainingAmount) {\r\n            amount = remainingAmount;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.amountRepaid += amount;\r\n\r\n        // Transfer repayment from borrower to lender\r\n        IERC20(loan.terms.tokenAddress).safeTransferFrom(\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loan.lender,\r\n            amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepayment(\r\n            loanId,\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            amount,\r\n            remainingAmount - amount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Check if fully repaid\r\n        if (loan.amountRepaid >= amountDue) {\r\n            _completeLoanRepayment(loanId);\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function liquidateLoan(uint256 loanId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotActive();\r\n\r\n        uint256 amountDue = LoanLogic.calculateAmountDue(\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount,\r\n            loan.terms.interestRate\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 unpaidAmount = amountDue - loan.amountRepaid;\r\n\r\n        bool isOverdueAndGracePassed = block.timestamp > loan.dueTime;\r\n\r\n        bool isUndercollateralised = false;\r\n        if (loan.collateralDepositId != 0) {\r\n            try\r\n                collateralManager.getTokenUSDValue(\r\n                    loan.terms.tokenAddress,\r\n                    unpaidAmount\r\n                )\r\n            returns (uint256 unpaidAmountUSD) {\r\n                try\r\n                    collateralManager.canLiquidate(loanId, unpaidAmountUSD)\r\n                returns (bool liquidatable) {\r\n                    isUndercollateralised = liquidatable;\r\n                } catch {}\r\n            } catch {}\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (!isOverdueAndGracePassed && !isUndercollateralised) {\r\n            revert LendingPool__LoanNotLiquidatable();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Liquidate collateral\r\n        uint256 recoveredAmount = 0;\r\n        if (loan.collateralDepositId != 0) {\r\n            uint256 unpaidAmountUSD = collateralManager.getTokenUSDValue(\r\n                loan.terms.tokenAddress,\r\n                unpaidAmount\r\n            );\r\n            recoveredAmount = collateralManager.liquidateCollateral(\r\n                loanId,\r\n                unpaidAmountUSD,\r\n                loan.lender,\r\n                isOverdueAndGracePassed\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.DEFAULTED;\r\n\r\n        // Apply reputation penalty to borrower\r\n        reputationManager.recordDefault(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner && address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getLoanCoSigners(\r\n                loanId\r\n            );\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                coSigningManager.releaseCoSigning(recordIds[i], false); // false = defaulted\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanDefaulted(loanId, loan.borrower, unpaidAmount);\r\n        emit CollateralLiquidated(loanId, loan.borrower, recoveredAmount);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function isLoanOverdue(uint256 loanId) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        Loan memory loan = loans[loanId];\r\n        if (loan.status != LoanStatus.ACTIVE) return false;\r\n        return block.timestamp > loan.dueTime;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getLoan(uint256 loanId) external view returns (Loan memory) {\r\n        return loans[loanId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getLoanOffer(\r\n        uint256 offerId\r\n    ) external view returns (LoanOffer memory) {\r\n        return loanOffers[offerId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveLenderOfferIds()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (uint256[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        return activeLenderOffers;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveBorrowerRequestIds()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (uint256[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        return activeBorrowerRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getUserLoans(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userLoans[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getUserOffers(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userOffers[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getNextLoanId() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return nextLoanId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getNextOfferId() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return nextOfferId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getPlatformFeeRate() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return platformFeeRate;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getBasisPoints() external pure returns (uint256) {\r\n        return BASIS_POINTS;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Admin Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function setPlatformFeeRate(\r\n        uint256 newFeeRate\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeRate > MAX_PLATFORM_FEE) revert LendingPool__InvalidFeeRate();\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldRate = platformFeeRate;\r\n        platformFeeRate = newFeeRate;\r\n\r\n        emit PlatformFeeRateUpdated(oldRate, newFeeRate);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function setFeeCollector(\r\n        address newFeeCollector\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (newFeeCollector == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        feeCollector = newFeeCollector;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function setCoSigningManager(\r\n        address _coSigningManager\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {\r\n        if (_coSigningManager == address(0)) revert LendingPool__ZeroAddress();\r\n        address old = address(coSigningManager);\r\n        coSigningManager = CoSigningManager(_coSigningManager);\r\n        emit CoSigningManagerUpdated(old, _coSigningManager);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function _completeLoanRepayment(uint256 loanId) internal {\r\n        Loan storage loan = loans[loanId];\r\n\r\n        loan.status = LoanStatus.REPAID;\r\n\r\n        // Unlock collateral\r\n        if (loan.collateralDepositId != 0) {\r\n            collateralManager.unlockCollateral(loan.collateralDepositId);\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Update borrower reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.borrower,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Update lender reputation\r\n        reputationManager.recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n            loan.lender,\r\n            loan.terms.principalAmount\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (loan.hasCoSigner && address(coSigningManager) != address(0)) {\r\n            // Find the record ID(s) for this loan\r\n            uint256[] memory recordIds = coSigningManager.getLoanCoSigners(\r\n                loanId\r\n            );\r\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n                coSigningManager.releaseCoSigning(recordIds[i], true); // true = successful\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit LoanRepaid(loanId, loan.borrower, loan.amountRepaid);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function _validateLoanTerms(\r\n        LoanTerms calldata terms,\r\n        LoanType offerType\r\n    ) internal pure {\r\n        if (terms.principalAmount == 0) revert LendingPool__InvalidAmount();\r\n        if (\r\n            terms.duration < MIN_LOAN_DURATION ||\r\n            terms.duration > MAX_LOAN_DURATION\r\n        ) revert LendingPool__InvalidDuration();\r\n        if (terms.interestRate > MAX_INTEREST_RATE)\r\n            revert LendingPool__InvalidInterestRate();\r\n\r\n        if (offerType == LoanType.LENDER_OFFER) {\r\n            if (\r\n                terms.collateralRatio != 0 &&\r\n                terms.collateralRatio < MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO\r\n            ) revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n        } else {\r\n            if (terms.collateralAmount > 0) {\r\n                if (terms.collateralRatio < MIN_COLLATERAL_RATIO)\r\n                    revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n            } else {\r\n                if (terms.collateralRatio != 0)\r\n                    revert LendingPool__InvalidCollateralRatio();\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x92e8be51e96294dca8938208c5a8f359b108eadc9f3ddacee0077cf4556f81a3","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/LoanLogic.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nlibrary LoanLogic {\r\n    uint256 internal constant BASIS_POINTS = 10000;\r\n\r\n    function calculateAmountDue(\r\n        uint256 principal,\r\n        uint256 interestRate\r\n    ) internal pure returns (uint256) {\r\n        return principal + (principal * interestRate) / BASIS_POINTS;\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x010dcac8a75869a5dfdde424cc73ee767d346716728b4427912496c615e68677","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/PriceOracle.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/shared/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\r\n\r\n// Wrapper contract for price feeds\r\ncontract PriceOracle is Ownable {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    // Mapping from token address to Chainlink price feed\r\n    mapping(address => AggregatorV3Interface) public priceFeeds;\r\n\r\n    // Mapping to track supported tokens\r\n    mapping(address => bool) public isSupportedToken;\r\n\r\n    // Array of all supported tokens\r\n    address[] public supportedTokens;\r\n\r\n    // Stale price threshold (default: 1 hour)\r\n    uint256 public stalePriceThreshold = 1 hours;\r\n\r\n    // Price deviation threshold for additional validation (in basis points)\r\n    // e.g., 5000 = 50% deviation allowed\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PRICE_DEVIATION = 5000; // 50%\r\n\r\n    // Decimals for USD price (standardized to 18 decimals)\r\n    uint8 public constant PRICE_DECIMALS = 18;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct PriceData {\r\n        uint256 price; // Price in USD (18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 timestamp; // When price was updated\r\n        uint80 roundId; // Chainlink round ID\r\n        bool isValid; // Whether price is valid\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedUpdated(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        address indexed priceFeed,\r\n        string tokenSymbol\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceFeedRemoved(address indexed token);\r\n\r\n    event PriceRetrieved(\r\n        address indexed token,\r\n        uint256 price,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event StalePriceThresholdUpdated(\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold,\r\n        uint256 newThreshold\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event PriceValidationFailed(address indexed token, string reason);\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n    error PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n    error PriceOracle__StalePrice(uint256 timeSinceUpdate);\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenAlreadySupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n    error PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n    error PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() Ownable() {}\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function setPriceFeed(\r\n        address token,\r\n        address priceFeed,\r\n        string calldata tokenSymbol\r\n    ) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (token == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__ZeroAddress();\r\n        if (priceFeed == address(0)) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n\r\n        // Validate price feed by attempting to get latest round data\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface feed = AggregatorV3Interface(priceFeed);\r\n        try feed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            if (answer <= 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPriceFeed();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Add to supported tokens if new\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) {\r\n            supportedTokens.push(token);\r\n            isSupportedToken[token] = true;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        priceFeeds[token] = feed;\r\n        emit PriceFeedUpdated(token, priceFeed, tokenSymbol);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function removePriceFeed(address token) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        delete priceFeeds[token];\r\n        isSupportedToken[token] = false;\r\n\r\n        // Remove from supported tokens array\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < supportedTokens.length; i++) {\r\n            if (supportedTokens[i] == token) {\r\n                supportedTokens[i] = supportedTokens[\r\n                    supportedTokens.length - 1\r\n                ];\r\n                supportedTokens.pop();\r\n                break;\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit PriceFeedRemoved(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getPrice(address token) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        PriceData memory priceData = _getPriceData(token);\r\n\r\n        if (!priceData.isValid) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return priceData.price;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (PriceData memory) {\r\n        return _getPriceData(token);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    //Get token value in USD\r\n    function getTokenValueInUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 valueInUSD) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        // Normalize token amount to 18 decimals, then multiply by price\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount * (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        } else {\r\n            // If token has > 18 decimals (rare), scale down\r\n            uint256 normalizedAmount = amount / (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n            valueInUSD = (normalizedAmount * price) / 1e18;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return valueInUSD;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // Get USD amount required for specific token amount\r\n    function getTokenAmountForUSD(\r\n        address token,\r\n        uint256 usdAmount,\r\n        uint8 tokenDecimals\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 tokenAmount) {\r\n        uint256 price = this.getPrice(token);\r\n\r\n        if (price == 0) revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n\r\n        // Calculate token amount needed (in 18 decimals)\r\n        uint256 tokenAmount18Decimals = (usdAmount * 1e18) / price;\r\n\r\n        // Convert to token's native decimals\r\n        if (tokenDecimals <= 18) {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals / (10 ** (18 - tokenDecimals));\r\n        } else {\r\n            tokenAmount = tokenAmount18Decimals * (10 ** (tokenDecimals - 18));\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return tokenAmount;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function isPriceStale(address token) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return true;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return block.timestamp - updatedAt > stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return true;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getSupportedTokens() external view returns (address[] memory) {\r\n        return supportedTokens;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getSupportedTokenCount() external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return supportedTokens.length;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function setStalePriceThreshold(uint256 newThreshold) external onlyOwner {\r\n        if (newThreshold <= 0) {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidThreshold();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldThreshold = stalePriceThreshold;\r\n        stalePriceThreshold = newThreshold;\r\n\r\n        emit StalePriceThresholdUpdated(oldThreshold, newThreshold);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getPriceFeedDecimals(address token) external view returns (uint8) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.decimals();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getPriceFeedDescription(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) external view returns (string memory) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        return priceFeed.description();\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function _getPriceData(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (PriceData memory priceData) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) revert PriceOracle__TokenNotSupported();\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n        if (address(priceFeed) == address(0))\r\n            revert PriceOracle__PriceFeedNotSet();\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80 roundId,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256 startedAt,\r\n            uint256 updatedAt,\r\n            uint80 answeredInRound\r\n        ) {\r\n            // Validate round data\r\n            if (answeredInRound < roundId) {\r\n                priceData.isValid = false;\r\n                return priceData;\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for stale price\r\n            uint256 timeSinceUpdate = block.timestamp - updatedAt;\r\n            if (timeSinceUpdate > stalePriceThreshold) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__StalePrice(timeSinceUpdate);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Check for invalid price\r\n            if (answer <= 0) {\r\n                revert PriceOracle__InvalidPrice();\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            // Get price feed decimals and normalize to 18 decimals\r\n            uint8 decimals = priceFeed.decimals();\r\n            uint256 price;\r\n\r\n            if (decimals < PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) * (10 ** (PRICE_DECIMALS - decimals));\r\n            } else if (decimals > PRICE_DECIMALS) {\r\n                price = uint256(answer) / (10 ** (decimals - PRICE_DECIMALS));\r\n            } else {\r\n                price = uint256(answer);\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            priceData = PriceData({\r\n                price: price,\r\n                timestamp: updatedAt,\r\n                roundId: roundId,\r\n                isValid: true\r\n            });\r\n        } catch {\r\n            revert PriceOracle__InvalidRoundData();\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function _isPriceFeedResponsive(\r\n        address token\r\n    ) internal view returns (bool) {\r\n        if (!isSupportedToken[token]) return false;\r\n\r\n        AggregatorV3Interface priceFeed = priceFeeds[token];\r\n\r\n        try priceFeed.latestRoundData() returns (\r\n            uint80,\r\n            int256 answer,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint256,\r\n            uint80\r\n        ) {\r\n            return answer > 0;\r\n        } catch {\r\n            return false;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n}\r\n","keccak256":"0x176d1e03e4c17ea05e5cba3f8f81929c5fc6b4a8f1215abd397aeef5f3ff3274","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/ReputationManager.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\n\r\n//Manages user reputation scores for decentralized lending platform\r\ncontract ReputationManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant COSIGNING_ROLE = keccak256(\"COSIGNING_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant VERIFIER_ROLE = keccak256(\"VERIFIER_ROLE\");\r\n    bytes32 public constant DATA_FEED_ROLE = keccak256(\"DATA_FEED_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    // Reputation score bounds\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_REPUTATION = 0;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION = 1000;\r\n    uint256 public constant STARTING_REPUTATION = 200;\r\n\r\n    // Reputation weights (out of 100 for percentage)\r\n    uint256 public constant REPAYMENT_WEIGHT = 20;\r\n    uint256 public constant TRANSACTION_WEIGHT = 45;\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_WEIGHT = 35;\r\n\r\n    // Decay parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_START_DAYS = 90;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_DECAY_PERCENTAGE = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant DECAY_PERIOD_DAYS = 180;\r\n\r\n    // Anti-gaming parameters\r\n    uint256 public constant REPUTATION_CAP_PERIOD = 1 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD = 100;\r\n    uint256 public constant WALLET_AGE_CAP_DAYS = 365;\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGN_COOLDOWN = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGN_BONUS = 100;\r\n\r\n    // Off-chain verification bonuses (exempt from daily cap)\r\n    uint256 public constant EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 60;\r\n    uint256 public constant PHONE_VERIFICATION_BONUS = 140;\r\n\r\n    // Repayment scoring\r\n    uint256 public constant SUCCESSFUL_REPAYMENT_BASE = 20;\r\n    uint256 public constant DEFAULT_PENALTY_BASE = 100;\r\n    uint256 public constant COSIGNER_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER = 30;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct ReputationData {\r\n        uint256 baseScore;\r\n        uint256 totalTransactions;\r\n        uint256 uniqueCounterparties;\r\n        uint256 totalValueTransferred;\r\n        uint256 successfulRepayments;\r\n        uint256 totalRepaymentValue;\r\n        uint256 defaults;\r\n        uint256 totalDefaultValue;\r\n        uint256 walletCreationTime;\r\n        uint256 lastActivityTimestamp;\r\n        uint256 lastReputationUpdate;\r\n        bool emailVerified;\r\n        bool phoneVerified;\r\n        uint256 reputationGainedToday;\r\n        uint256 lastDailyResetTimestamp;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningHistory {\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) coSignCount;\r\n        mapping(address => uint256) lastCoSignTime;\r\n        uint256 totalActiveCoSigns;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Storage ============\r\n\r\n    mapping(address => ReputationData) private reputationData;\r\n    mapping(address => CoSigningHistory) private coSigningHistory;\r\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private hasInteracted;\r\n    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => uint256))\r\n        public coSigningBonusByOffer;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event ReputationUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 oldScore,\r\n        uint256 newScore,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OffChainVerification(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        string verificationType,\r\n        uint256 bonusAdded\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationDecay(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 decayAmount,\r\n        uint256 daysSinceActivity\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ReputationPenalty(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount,\r\n        string reason\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event OnChainMetricsUpdated(\r\n        address indexed user,\r\n        uint256 transactions,\r\n        uint256 counterparties,\r\n        uint256 totalValue\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error ReputationManager__Unauthorized();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n    error ReputationManager__ReputationCapReached();\r\n    error ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor() {\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(VERIFIER_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function getReputationScore(address user) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getReputationData(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (ReputationData memory) {\r\n        return reputationData[user];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function initializeReputation(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE) {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n\r\n        if (data.walletCreationTime == 0) {\r\n            data.baseScore = STARTING_REPUTATION;\r\n            data.walletCreationTime = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastReputationUpdate = block.timestamp;\r\n            data.lastDailyResetTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n            emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n                user,\r\n                0,\r\n                STARTING_REPUTATION,\r\n                \"Initial reputation\"\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    //Record successful loan repayment and update reputation.\r\n    function recordSuccessfulRepayment(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        data.successfulRepayments++;\r\n        data.totalRepaymentValue += loanAmount;\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        uint256 bonus = _calculateRepaymentBonus(loanAmount);\r\n\r\n        // Clamp to remaining daily allowance before applying\r\n        bonus = _clampToDailyCap(borrower, bonus);\r\n\r\n        if (bonus > 0) {\r\n            data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + bonus, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n            data.reputationGainedToday += bonus;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Successful repayment\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function recordDefault(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        if (loanAmount == 0) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAmount();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        data.defaults++;\r\n        data.totalDefaultValue += loanAmount;\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        uint256 penalty = _calculateDefaultPenalty(\r\n            loanAmount,\r\n            data.totalRepaymentValue\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (data.baseScore > penalty) {\r\n            data.baseScore -= penalty;\r\n        } else {\r\n            data.baseScore = MIN_REPUTATION;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n        emit ReputationPenalty(borrower, penalty, \"Loan default\");\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Default penalty applied\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    //Record off-chain verification (email/phone).\r\n    function recordOffChainVerification(\r\n        address user,\r\n        string calldata verificationType\r\n    ) external onlyRole(VERIFIER_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(user);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n        uint256 bonus = 0;\r\n\r\n        if (keccak256(bytes(verificationType)) == keccak256(bytes(\"email\"))) {\r\n            if (data.emailVerified) revert ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n            data.emailVerified = true;\r\n            bonus = EMAIL_VERIFICATION_BONUS;\r\n        } else if (\r\n            keccak256(bytes(verificationType)) == keccak256(bytes(\"phone\"))\r\n        ) {\r\n            if (data.phoneVerified) revert ReputationManager__AlreadyVerified();\r\n            data.phoneVerified = true;\r\n            bonus = PHONE_VERIFICATION_BONUS;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (bonus > 0) {\r\n            // Applied directly \u2014 no daily cap\r\n            data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + bonus, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n            uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(user);\r\n            emit OffChainVerification(user, verificationType, bonus);\r\n            emit ReputationUpdated(user, oldScore, newScore, verificationType);\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function addCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation,\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) nonReentrant returns (uint256) {\r\n        if (borrower == address(0) || coSigner == address(0)) {\r\n            revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(borrower);\r\n        _ensureInitialized(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        uint256 bonus = _calculateCoSigningBonus(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            coSignerReputation\r\n        );\r\n        if (bonus > 0) {\r\n            ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n\r\n            coSigningBonusByOffer[borrower][loanOfferId] = _min(\r\n                coSigningBonusByOffer[borrower][loanOfferId] + bonus,\r\n                MAX_COSIGN_BONUS\r\n            );\r\n            data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Always update co-signing history (for diminishing returns tracking)\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n        history.coSignCount[borrower]++;\r\n        history.lastCoSignTime[borrower] = block.timestamp;\r\n        history.totalActiveCoSigns++;\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Co-signing bonus pending\"\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return bonus;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function applyOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) nonReentrant returns (uint256) {\r\n        uint256 bonus = coSigningBonusByOffer[borrower][loanOfferId];\r\n        if (bonus == 0) return 0;\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[borrower];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n\r\n        data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + bonus, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n        delete coSigningBonusByOffer[borrower][loanOfferId];\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(borrower);\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            borrower,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Co-signing bonus applied\"\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return bonus;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function clearOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) {\r\n        delete coSigningBonusByOffer[borrower][loanOfferId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function penalizeCoSigner(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanAmount\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (coSigner == address(0) || borrower == address(0)) {\r\n            revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[coSigner];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        uint256 borrowerPenalty = _calculateDefaultPenalty(loanAmount, 0);\r\n        uint256 coSignerPenalty = (borrowerPenalty *\r\n            COSIGNER_PENALTY_MULTIPLIER) / 100;\r\n\r\n        if (data.baseScore > coSignerPenalty) {\r\n            data.baseScore -= coSignerPenalty;\r\n        } else {\r\n            data.baseScore = MIN_REPUTATION;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n        if (history.totalActiveCoSigns > 0) {\r\n            history.totalActiveCoSigns--;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n        emit ReputationPenalty(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            coSignerPenalty,\r\n            \"Co-signed loan defaulted\"\r\n        );\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Co-signer penalty\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function rewardCoSigner(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        if (coSigner == address(0) || borrower == address(0)) {\r\n            revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[coSigner];\r\n        uint256 oldScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n\r\n        uint256 reward = _clampToDailyCap(coSigner, 10);\r\n\r\n        if (reward > 0) {\r\n            data.baseScore = _min(data.baseScore + reward, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n            data.reputationGainedToday += reward;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n        if (history.totalActiveCoSigns > 0) {\r\n            history.totalActiveCoSigns--;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 newScore = _calculateReputationScore(coSigner);\r\n        emit ReputationUpdated(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            oldScore,\r\n            newScore,\r\n            \"Co-signing reward\"\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function updateOnChainMetrics(\r\n        address user,\r\n        uint256 txCount,\r\n        address counterparty,\r\n        uint256 txValue\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DATA_FEED_ROLE) {\r\n        if (user == address(0)) revert ReputationManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        _ensureInitialized(user);\r\n\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n\r\n        data.totalTransactions += txCount;\r\n\r\n        if (counterparty != address(0) && !hasInteracted[user][counterparty]) {\r\n            hasInteracted[user][counterparty] = true;\r\n            data.uniqueCounterparties++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (txValue > 0.01 ether) {\r\n            data.totalValueTransferred += txValue;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        data.lastActivityTimestamp = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        emit OnChainMetricsUpdated(\r\n            user,\r\n            data.totalTransactions,\r\n            data.uniqueCounterparties,\r\n            data.totalValueTransferred\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function decrementActiveCoSigns(\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external onlyRole(COSIGNING_ROLE) {\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n        if (history.totalActiveCoSigns > 0) {\r\n            history.totalActiveCoSigns--;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function meetsReputationRequirement(\r\n        address user,\r\n        uint256 minimumReputation\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return _calculateReputationScore(user) >= minimumReputation;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSignCount(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return coSigningHistory[coSigner].coSignCount[borrower];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        return coSigningBonusByOffer[borrower][loanOfferId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function hasDiminishingReturns(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        CoSigningHistory storage history = coSigningHistory[coSigner];\r\n        if (\r\n            block.timestamp < history.lastCoSignTime[borrower] + COSIGN_COOLDOWN\r\n        ) {\r\n            return history.coSignCount[borrower] > 0;\r\n        }\r\n        return false;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getRemainingDailyCap(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n        if (block.timestamp >= data.lastDailyResetTimestamp + 1 days) {\r\n            return MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD / 2;\r\n        }\r\n        if (data.reputationGainedToday >= MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD) {\r\n            return 0;\r\n        }\r\n        return\r\n            (MAX_REPUTATION_GAIN_PER_PERIOD - data.reputationGainedToday) / 2;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Internal Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function _calculateReputationScore(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) internal view returns (uint256) {\r\n        ReputationData storage data = reputationData[user];\r\n        if (data.walletCreationTime == 0) return 0;\r\n\r\n        uint256 score = data.baseScore;\r\n\r\n        uint256 defaultPenaltyScore = _calculateRepaymentScore(data);\r\n        uint256 transactionScore = _calculateTransactionScore(data);\r\n        uint256 walletAgeScore = _calculateWalletAgeScore(data);\r\n\r\n        uint256 weightedBonus = (transactionScore *\r\n            TRANSACTION_WEIGHT +\r\n            walletAgeScore *\r\n            WALLET_AGE_WEIGHT) / 80;\r\n\r\n        uint256 weightedPenalty = (defaultPenaltyScore * REPAYMENT_WEIGHT) /\r\n            100;\r\n\r\n        score = (score + weightedBonus) / 2;\r\n\r\n        if (score > weightedPenalty) {\r\n            score -= weightedPenalty;\r\n        } else {\r\n            score = MIN_REPUTATION;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        uint256 decayAmount = _calculateDecay(data);\r\n        score = score > decayAmount ? score - decayAmount : MIN_REPUTATION;\r\n\r\n        return _min(score, MAX_REPUTATION);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function _calculateRepaymentScore(\r\n        ReputationData storage data\r\n    ) internal view returns (uint256) {\r\n        if (data.defaults == 0) return 0;\r\n\r\n        uint256 defaultPenalty = data.defaults * 80;\r\n\r\n        uint256 mitigationScore = 0;\r\n        if (data.totalRepaymentValue > 0) {\r\n            mitigationScore = _min(\r\n                (data.totalRepaymentValue / 1 ether) * 2,\r\n                60\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if (mitigationScore >= defaultPenalty) return 0;\r\n        return _min(defaultPenalty - mitigationScore, 300);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function _calculateTransactionScore(\r\n        ReputationData storage data\r\n    ) internal view returns (uint256) {\r\n        uint256 txScore = _min(data.totalTransactions * 2, 100);\r\n        uint256 diversityScore = _min(data.uniqueCounterparties * 5, 100);\r\n        uint256 valueScore = 0;\r\n        if RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this. _Available since v3.1._

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this. _Available since v3.1._

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call, an admin role bearer except when using {AccessControl-_setupRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `account`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol\";\r\nimport \"@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\r\nimport \"./ReputationManager.sol\";\r\nimport \"./LendingPool.sol\";\r\n\r\n//Manages co-signing relationships where trusted users can vouch for borrowers\r\ncontract CoSigningManager is AccessControl, ReentrancyGuard {\r\n    // ============ State Variables ============\r\n\r\n    ReputationManager public immutable reputationManager;\r\n    LendingPool public immutable lendingPool;\r\n\r\n    bytes32 public constant LENDING_POOL_ROLE = keccak256(\"LENDING_POOL_ROLE\");\r\n\r\n    // Counters\r\n    uint256 public nextRequestId = 1;\r\n    uint256 public nextRecordId = 1;\r\n\r\n    // Storage\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRequest) public coSigningRequests;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => CoSigningRecord) public coSigningRecords;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public loanCoSigners; // loanId      => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userRequests; // borrower    => requestIds[]\r\n    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userCoSignings; // coSigner    => recordIds[]\r\n    mapping(uint256 => address) public offerCoSigner;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public offerToCoSignRecord;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => bool) public offerHasActiveRequest;\r\n\r\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public offerToRecords; // loanOfferId => recordIds[]\r\n\r\n    // Co-signing limits\r\n    uint256 public constant MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION = 50; //to be changed back to 200\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE = 50;\r\n    uint256 public constant COOLDOWN_PERIOD = 30 days;\r\n    uint256 public constant MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN = 3;\r\n\r\n    // ============ Structs ============\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRequest {\r\n        uint256 requestId;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n        string message;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct CoSigningRecord {\r\n        uint256 recordId;\r\n        address coSigner;\r\n        address borrower;\r\n        uint256 loanId;\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId;\r\n        uint256 reputationStaked;\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided;\r\n        uint256 coSignTimestamp;\r\n        bool isActive;\r\n        bool loanCompleted;\r\n        bool borrowerDefaulted;\r\n        bool wasCancelled;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ Events ============\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 indexed loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string message\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRequestCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed requestId,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningCompleted(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningReleased(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerPenalized(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 penaltyAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSignerRewarded(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower,\r\n        uint256 rewardAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n        uint256 indexed recordId,\r\n        address indexed coSigner,\r\n        address indexed borrower\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    // ============ Errors ============\r\n\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RecordAlreadyLinked();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__CoSignerCannotBeLender();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__RequestAlreadyExists();\r\n    error CoSigningManager__AlreadyCoSigned();\r\n\r\n    // ============ Constructor ============\r\n\r\n    constructor(address _reputationManager, address _lendingPool) {\r\n        if (_reputationManager == address(0) || _lendingPool == address(0)) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        reputationManager = ReputationManager(_reputationManager);\r\n        lendingPool = LendingPool(_lendingPool);\r\n\r\n        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);\r\n        _grantRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE, _lendingPool);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ External Functions - Request Management ============\r\n\r\n    function createCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        uint256 requestedBonus,\r\n        string calldata message\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 requestId) {\r\n        if (requestedBonus == 0) revert CoSigningManager__InvalidBonus();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.LoanOffer memory offer = lendingPool.getLoanOffer(\r\n            loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n        if (offer.creator == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n\r\n        // Only the offer creator can request co-signing for their own offer\r\n        if (offer.creator != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        // Block duplicate active requests for the same offer\r\n        if (offerHasActiveRequest[loanOfferId])\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestAlreadyExists();\r\n\r\n        // Block if already co-signed (accepted)\r\n        if (offerCoSigner[loanOfferId] != address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__AlreadyCoSigned();\r\n\r\n        requestId = nextRequestId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRequests[requestId] = CoSigningRequest({\r\n            requestId: requestId,\r\n            borrower: msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId: loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus: requestedBonus,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp,\r\n            message: message\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userRequests[msg.sender].push(requestId);\r\n        offerHasActiveRequest[loanOfferId] = true;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCreated(\r\n            requestId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            loanOfferId,\r\n            requestedBonus,\r\n            message\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return requestId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRequest(uint256 requestId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (request.borrower != msg.sender)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n        delete offerCoSigner[request.loanOfferId];\r\n        offerHasActiveRequest[request.loanOfferId] = false;\r\n        emit CoSigningRequestCancelled(requestId, msg.sender);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function acceptCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant returns (uint256 recordId) {\r\n        CoSigningRequest storage request = coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n\r\n        if (request.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotFound();\r\n        if (!request.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RequestNotActive();\r\n        if (msg.sender == request.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CannotCoSignSelf();\r\n\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            msg.sender\r\n        );\r\n        if (coSignerReputation < MIN_COSIGNER_REPUTATION) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InsufficientReputation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Actual bonus determined by ReputationManager \u2014 requestedBonus is ignored here\r\n        uint256 bonusProvided = reputationManager.addCoSigningBonus(\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            coSignerReputation,\r\n            request.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        recordId = nextRecordId++;\r\n\r\n        coSigningRecords[recordId] = CoSigningRecord({\r\n            recordId: recordId,\r\n            coSigner: msg.sender,\r\n            borrower: request.borrower,\r\n            loanId: 0,\r\n            loanOfferId: request.loanOfferId,\r\n            reputationStaked: coSignerReputation,\r\n            bonusProvided: bonusProvided,\r\n            coSignTimestamp: block.timestamp,\r\n            isActive: true,\r\n            loanCompleted: false,\r\n            borrowerDefaulted: false,\r\n            wasCancelled: false\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        userCoSignings[msg.sender].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        //   look up this record by offer ID and reverse the bonus if needed.\r\n        offerToRecords[request.loanOfferId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        offerCoSigner[request.loanOfferId] = msg.sender;\r\n\r\n        offerToCoSignRecord[request.loanOfferId] = recordId;\r\n\r\n        // Deactivate the request \u2014 one co-signer per request\r\n        request.isActive = false;\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            msg.sender,\r\n            request.borrower,\r\n            0,\r\n            bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        return recordId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function cancelCoSigningRecord(uint256 recordId) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        // Only the borrower or LendingPool (admin) can cancel\r\n        if (\r\n            msg.sender != record.borrower &&\r\n            !hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender)\r\n        ) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__UnauthorizedCancellation();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n        record.wasCancelled = true;\r\n\r\n        // Reverse the reputation bonus given to the borrower\r\n        reputationManager.clearOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        // Decrement the co-signer's active co-sign count\r\n        reputationManager.decrementActiveCoSigns(record.coSigner);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningRecordCancelled(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower\r\n        );\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            false\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function addCoSignerToLoan(\r\n        uint256 loanId,\r\n        uint256 coSignRecordId\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[coSignRecordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        LendingPool.Loan memory loan = lendingPool.getLoan(loanId);\r\n        if (loan.borrower == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__LoanNotFound();\r\n        if (loan.borrower != record.borrower)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__InvalidAddress();\r\n\r\n        if (loan.lender == record.coSigner)\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__CoSignerCannotBeLender();\r\n\r\n        if (loanCoSigners[loanId].length >= MAX_COSIGNERS_PER_LOAN) {\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__MaxCoSignersReached();\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(coSignRecordId);\r\n\r\n        reputationManager.applyOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            coSignRecordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    //logic for either repayment or default\r\n    function releaseCoSigning(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        bool successfulRepayment\r\n    ) external nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n\r\n        record.isActive = false;\r\n        record.loanCompleted = true;\r\n\r\n        // Clear the borrower's co-signing bonus on release\r\n        reputationManager.clearOfferCoSigningBonus(\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            record.loanOfferId\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (successfulRepayment) {\r\n            reputationManager.rewardCoSigner(record.coSigner, record.borrower);\r\n            emit CoSignerRewarded(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                10\r\n            );\r\n        } else {\r\n            record.borrowerDefaulted = true;\r\n            reputationManager.penalizeCoSigner(\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked\r\n            );\r\n            emit CoSignerPenalized(\r\n                recordId,\r\n                record.coSigner,\r\n                record.borrower,\r\n                record.reputationStaked / 3\r\n            );\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            successfulRepayment\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function linkRecordToLoan(\r\n        uint256 recordId,\r\n        uint256 loanId\r\n    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) nonReentrant {\r\n        CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n\r\n        if (record.coSigner == address(0))\r\n            revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotFound();\r\n        if (!record.isActive) revert CoSigningManager__RecordNotActive();\r\n        if (record.loanId != 0) revert CoSigningManager__RecordAlreadyLinked();\r\n\r\n        record.loanId = loanId;\r\n        loanCoSigners[loanId].push(recordId);\r\n\r\n        emit CoSigningCompleted(\r\n            recordId,\r\n            record.coSigner,\r\n            record.borrower,\r\n            loanId,\r\n            record.bonusProvided\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    // ============ View Functions ============\r\n\r\n    function getRecordsByOffer(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return offerToRecords[loanOfferId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function calculateCoSigningBonus(\r\n        address borrower,\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256 bonus) {\r\n        uint256 coSignerReputation = reputationManager.getReputationScore(\r\n            coSigner\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 baseBonus = (coSignerReputation * MAX_BONUS_PERCENTAGE) / 100;\r\n        uint256 coSignCount = reputationManager.getCoSignCount(\r\n            coSigner,\r\n            borrower\r\n        );\r\n\r\n        if (coSignCount == 0) {\r\n            return baseBonus;\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 1) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 60) / 100;\r\n        } else if (coSignCount == 2) {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 30) / 100;\r\n        } else {\r\n            return (baseBonus * 10) / 100;\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function handleOfferCancelled(\r\n        uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external onlyRole(LENDING_POOL_ROLE) {\r\n        reputationManager.clearOfferCoSigningBonus(borrower, loanOfferId);\r\n\r\n        uint256 recordId = offerToCoSignRecord[loanOfferId];\r\n        if (recordId != 0) {\r\n            CoSigningRecord storage record = coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n            if (record.isActive) {\r\n                record.isActive = false;\r\n                reputationManager.decrementActiveCoSigns(record.coSigner);\r\n                emit CoSigningReleased(\r\n                    recordId,\r\n                    record.coSigner,\r\n                    borrower,\r\n                    false\r\n                );\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        delete offerCoSigner[loanOfferId];\r\n        delete offerToCoSignRecord[loanOfferId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningRecord(\r\n        uint256 recordId\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRecord memory) {\r\n        return coSigningRecords[recordId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningRequest(\r\n        uint256 requestId\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest memory) {\r\n        return coSigningRequests[requestId];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userRequests[borrower];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveCoSigningRequests(\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory requestIds = userRequests[borrower];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) activeCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory activeRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < requestIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRequests[index++] = coSigningRequests[requestIds[i]];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getUserCoSignings(\r\n        address coSigner\r\n    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {\r\n        return userCoSignings[coSigner];\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getActiveCoSignings(\r\n        address user\r\n    ) external view returns (CoSigningRecord[] memory) {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = userCoSignings[user];\r\n        uint256 activeCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) activeCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRecord[] memory activeRecords = new CoSigningRecord[](\r\n            activeCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]].isActive) {\r\n                activeRecords[index++] = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return activeRecords;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function hasDiminishingReturns(\r\n        address coSigner,\r\n        address borrower\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return reputationManager.hasDiminishingReturns(coSigner, borrower);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getCoSigningStats(\r\n        address user\r\n    )\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (\r\n            uint256 totalCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 activeCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 successfulCoSignings,\r\n            uint256 defaultedCoSignings\r\n        )\r\n    {\r\n        uint256[] memory recordIds = userCoSignings[user];\r\n        totalCoSignings = recordIds.length;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recordIds.length; i++) {\r\n            CoSigningRecord memory record = coSigningRecords[recordIds[i]];\r\n            if (record.isActive) {\r\n                activeCoSignings++;\r\n            } else if (record.loanCompleted) {\r\n                if (record.borrowerDefaulted) {\r\n                    defaultedCoSignings++;\r\n                } else if (!record.wasCancelled) {\r\n                    successfulCoSignings++;\r\n                }\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return (\r\n            totalCoSignings,\r\n            activeCoSignings,\r\n            successfulCoSignings,\r\n            defaultedCoSignings\r\n        );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getAllOpenRequests()\r\n        external\r\n        view\r\n        returns (CoSigningRequest[] memory)\r\n    {\r\n        uint256 totalRequests = nextRequestId - 1;\r\n        uint256 openCount = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) openCount++;\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        CoSigningRequest[] memory openRequests = new CoSigningRequest[](\r\n            openCount\r\n        );\r\n        uint256 index = 0;\r\n\r\n        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= totalRequests; i++) {\r\n            if (coSigningRequests[i].isActive) {\r\n                openRequests[index++] = coSigningRequests[i];\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return openRequests;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n      uint256 loanOfferId,\r\n        address account\r\n    ) external view returns (bool) {\r\n        return offerCoSigner[loanOfferId] == account;\r\n
